Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
DOC-0052 2026-09-07
RETROSPECTIVE — The Review Appointment Stayed in the
Collecting Folder
Date: 2026-09-07
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
Recorder: PERSON-0031, TEAM-0001
What happened During the hydraulics desk's intake cycle, the scheduling
request stayed with the collecting papers instead of reaching the review roster
clerk. The diary line mixed the expected attachment delivery with the
intended reviewer conversation. ISSUE-0029 and TASK-0077 locate the
example folder; TASK-0076 and TASK-0078 remain separately referenced
discussion papers.
What helped The desk coordinator compared the collecting list with the
appointment diary before handover. That comparison exposed the missing
scheduling action without needing a claim about the underlying task
categories. The collecting clerk could explain when the Papers were expected,
and the roster clerk could separately discuss receiving availability.
What changes Give the diary separate lines for paper delivery and reviewer
availability. Each line needs a responsible role, contact time, and the action
expected from that contact. The reviewer request must reach the roster clerk
even when gathering work continues.
The incoming coordinator will compare the diary against the collecting list at
the next handover. A paper-delivery promise must not stand in for a named
receiving reviewer. Preserve a moved appointment beside its original entry so
the reason for delay remains visible.
Follow-up PERSON-0081 will review the revised diary with the collecting
clerk on 2026-09-08. The roster clerk will check the receiving-role line on
2026-09-09 and return any missing assignment question to the desk lead.
D. Worker 0037
Demo Worker 0031, Demo Team 01
